answer.rationale: Use a tightly targeted, time-limited retention offer only for demonstrably price-sensitive SMB accounts at elevated churn risk. Promotional pricing has shown acquisition and revenue lift in this segment, making it the most directly responsive option to the competitor cut; however, it materially reduced 30-day retention and should not be broadly rolled out. Guardrails should include qualified-revenue and post-discount retention monitoring, with no expansion absent evidence that incremental retained value offsets the retention harm.
